body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Gain +1 Fortitude against melee attacks and suppress one ordinary Slowed Condition until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Also suppress one ordinary penalty to your Success Die until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Evasion
rider.html: When an enemy misses a melee attack against you, move 1 unit into a space adjacent to it; that move does not trigger movement Reactions.
